spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Occupied or engaged by, actively intent on.
n. (-तं)
1 Coition, copulation.
2 A privity, a private part.
E.
रम to sport, क्त aff.

m. (-लः)
A dog.
E.
रत copulation, and कील a pin, a fastening.

n. (-तं)
Lascivious murmur.
E.
रत copulation, and कूजित murmur.

m. (-रुः)
A husband.
E.
रत copulation, and गुरु teacher.

m. (-रः)
A crow.
E.
रत coition, ज्वर fever.

m. (-ली)
A libertine, a lecher, a whoremonger.
E.
रत copulation, तल to complete, aff. णिनि.

f. (-ली)
A bawd, a procuress.
E.
रत copulation, तल to complete or effect, and अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.

m. (-चः)
1 A dog.
2 KĀMA or love.
3 Sonitus in coitu.
4 A libertine, a lecher.
E.
रत coition, नारी a female, चि to collect, or चर to go, aff. क or ड.

m. (-धिः)
A wagtail.
E.
रत copulation, निधि a treasure.

n. (-कं)
1 A day.
2 Bathing for pleasure.
3 The aggregate of four auspicious objects, &c.
E.
रत copulation, ऋधि increase, aff. कन्.

m. (-णः)
A dog.
E.
रत copulation, and व्रण a sore.

m. (-यी)
A dog.
E.
रत copulation, and शायिन् who sleeps.

m. (-कः)
1 A libertine, a lecher.
2 A ravisher, one who carries off and violates a woman.
E.
रत coition, हिडि to go, aff. वुन्.

m. (-कः)
A dog.
E.
रत copulation, and अन्दुक a chain.

f. (-न्ध्री)
Fog, mist.

m. (-र्द्धः)
A dog.
E.
रत coition, आङ् before मृध to rub, aff. अच्.

f. (-नी)
A whore, a harlot.
E.
रत copulation, अयन a going.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Libidinous, lascivious.
f. (-नी)
A libidinous woman, a wanton harlot.
E.
रत copulation, अथ seeking, soliciting, इनि and ङीष् affs.

f. (-तिः)
1 Passion, desire.
2 Coition, copulation.
3 A privity, a private part.
4 The wife of KĀMADEVA.
E.
रम to sport, aff. क्तिन्.

n. (-रः)
Pudendum muliebre.
E.
रति copulation, and कुहर a cavity.

f. (-या)
Copulation.
E.
रति the same, and क्रिया act.

n. (-हं)
The vagina.
E.
रति, and गृह abode, place.

m. (-तिः)
The deity of love, KĀMADEVA.
E.
रति the wife of the god, and पति husband.

m. (-यः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
रति the wife of the deity, and प्रिय beloved.

f. (-दा)
A courtezan of INDRA'S heaven.
E.
रति copulation, मद to delight, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

n. (-रं)
Pudendum muliebre.
E.
रति copulation, and मन्दिर abode.

m. (-णः)
KĀMADEVA, the god of love.
E.
रति the goddess so named, and रसण husband.

n. (-क्षं)
Copulation.

f. (-रा)
A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)
E.
रति copulation, सत्वर quick; perhaps considered as an aphrodisiac.

f. (-तूः)
1 The Ganges of heaven.
2 An honest woman, one who speaks the truth.
E.
ऋत a Sautra root, कू Uṇādi aff., and अम् augment.

m. (-हः)
The Koil or Indian cuckoo.
E.
रत copulation, उद्वह exciting.

n. (-त्नं)
1 A jewel, a gem.
2 Any thing the best of its kind, or figuratively, the jewel of the species.
E.
रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. न, and त substituted for the radical final.

m. (-लः)
Coral.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and कन्दल a shoot.

m. (-टः)
A mountain in the Dekshin.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and कूट a peak.

m. (-र्भः)
1 The god of wealth,

KUVERA.
2

The ocean.
f. (-र्भा)
The earth.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and गर्भ embryo.

f. (-भा)
The first of the seven hells or purgatories, according to the Jainas.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and प्रभा splendour.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Gemmed, full or made of gems.
E.
रत्न, and मयट् aff.

n. (-ख्यं)
The diamond.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and मुख्य chief.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having gems.
f. (-ती)
The earth.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-कं)
The carriage of KUVERA.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and वर्षुक showering.

m. (-क्षः)
Coral.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and वृक्ष a tree.

m. (-नुः)
The mountain Meru.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and सानु ridge of a mountain.

f. (-सूः)
The earth.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and सू a mother.

m. (-रः)
1 The ocean.
2 A jewel mine.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and आकर a mine.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The car of VIṢṆU.
E.
रत्न a jewel, and अङ्क mark.

f. (-लिः)
A necklace of gems.
E.
रत्न, and आवलि a row; also रत्नावली.

mf. (-त्निः-त्नी)
1 A sort of cubit, measured from the elbow to the end of the closed fist; it is also computed at twenty-one breadths of the middle of the thumb.
2 The closed hand, the fist.
E.
ऋ to go, कत्निच् aff., the vowel changed to the semivowel, otherwise अरत्नि, and as derived from सृ to go, सरत्नि.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The male or female organ.
E.
रति copulation, अङ्ग member.

n. (-कं)
A period of five nights collectively.
m. (-कः)
A man who takes up his abode in a harlot's house for one year.
E.
रात्रि night, and कन् aff.

f. (-त्रिः-त्री)
Night.
E.
रा to give, (pleasure or rest,) त्रिप् Uṇādi aff., ङीप् optionally added.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Going or moving at night.
m. (-रः)
1 A goblin, a fiend, a ghost or evil spirit.
2 A thief, a robber.
3 A guard, a patrole.
E.
रात्रि night, (by night,) and चर who goes.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Nocturnal, born or produced at night.
n. (-जं)
A star, a constellation.
E.
रात्रि night, and ज born.

n. (-लं)
Dew, mist, fog.
E.
रात्रि night, and जल water.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Keeping watch at night, sitting up at night.
m. (-रः)
A dog.
E.
रात्रि night, and जागर who wakes.

n. (-णं)
Sitting up all night.
E.
रात्रि, and जागरण waking.

m. (-दः)
A musquito, a gnat.
E.
रात्रिजागर waking by night, and द who gives or makes, from दा to give, or from दो to cut, who stings.

m. (-रः)
A ghost, a goblin.
E.
रात्रि night, चर to go, ट aff., and मुम् augment; also रात्रिचर.

m. (-टः)
1 A ghost, a goblin.
2 A theif.
3 A guard.
4 A night-walker.
E.
रात्रि night, अट to go, aff. अच्, and मुम् augment.

m. (-णिः)
The moon.
E.
रात्रि night, and मणि a jewel.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Thinking it night.
E.
रात्रि, and मन्य who believes, खच् aff.

m. (-गः)
Coming on of night.
E.
रात्रि, and योग joining.

n. (-सः)
Darkness.
E.
रात्रि night, and वासस् vesture.

m. (-मः)
Dawn, day-light.
E.
रात्रि night, विगम stop, cessation.

m. (-मी)
The ruddy goose.
E.
रात्रि night, विश्लेष separation, and गामिन् who goes, these birds being supposed to pass the night apart.

m. (-दः)
A cock.
E.
रात्रि the night, and वेद who knows, who knows its measure or duration.

m. (-दी)
A cock.
E.
रात्रि night, and वेदिन् who knows: see the last.

m. (-सः)
The white lotus.
E.
रात्रि night, and हास what smiles, blossoming at night.

m. (-कः)
A guard of the interior or women's apartments.
E.
रात्रि night, हिडि to go, क्वुन् aff.

m. (-टः)
1 An imp, a goblin.
2 A ghost.
3 A thief.
4 A night-walker.
E.
रात्रि night, अट to go, aff. अच्; also with a nasal inserted, रात्रिमट.
